decision: Insert a new current Module 9 design-critique practicum; renumber the former Modules 9, 10, and 11 to display Modules 10, 11, and 12; use the globally unique current outcome map O9.6-O9.9 for the practicum, O10.5-O10.9 for implementation, O11.5-O11.8 for testing, and O12.1-O12.4 for review; retain the proposed parent filename and the opaque lineage keys training.modules9-11, training.modules9-11.implementation, training.modules9-11.gates, and training.modules9-11.review, including the capstone dependency on training.modules9-11; allow old-number text only at an exact occurrence and semantic field/value allowlist, never by file, directory, object, symbol, or container name; treat this as a one-time pre-MVP exception that neither reuses those lineage keys nor weakens the general stable-ID rule.

governingRule.description: The accepted issue #4 remedy requires a collision-free pre-MVP module insertion while preserving historical lineage and completed evidence byte-for-byte.

alternativesConsidered.option: Keep the three former module display numbers and place the practicum elsewhere
Renumber opaque lineage IDs and historical records together with learner-facing modules
Permit stale numbering by broad file or historicalLineage-container exemptions

whyWinner: The chosen mapping gives the required practicum a stable current identity, preserves immutable history and dependency identity, and makes stale current assertions mechanically detectable without container laundering.
revisitTrigger: Revisit only before MVP if a collision-free outcome map cannot be verified or if a required historical reference cannot be expressed with an exact semantic occurrence allowlist.
